text:
maria: TL;DR: Gamma region launch tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Plan = staggered ramp -> soak -> autoscaler tuning. Need runbook signoff, oncall handoff, and rollback criteria.

ajay: What's the target QPS / GPUs? Need token/sec per GPU to size the load generator.

maria: Target steady QPS ~1200 across region. Rough calc: ~50 qps/GPU => 24 GPUs at full tilt. Ramp plan: 25% / 50% / 75% / 100% across 1h (15m steps). Soak: 6h at ~60% (~15 GPUs) then 6h at ~80%.

kevin: Note: KV cache priming required. We'll prime popular prefixes at 25% and 50% steps. I’ll push a priming job after the pool reaches 25%.

nico: Autoscaler tuning proposal: lower scale-out threshold to 55% GPU_util for the first 4h, scale-in cooldown = 10m, max surge +2 nodes. Add queue-length backoff: if API queue > 500, apply gentle throttle to clients to avoid thundering herd.

sarah: @maria I'm oncall 09-21 UTC. Rollback criteria? If p50 latency >300ms for 5m or 5xxs spike we should abort.

maria: Rollback (explicit): p50 > 300ms for 5m OR p95 token latency >1.5s OR API 5xx >1% sustained for 3m. Action = divert traffic to fallback region (eu-west) and scale up dedicated pool in fallback.

ajay: Load test quick commands to reproduce: use vegeta for steady runs and k6 for spikes. Examples: `vegeta attack -rate=1200 -duration=30m | vegeta report` and `k6 run spike.js --vus 300 --duration 10m`.

kevin: Heads-up: Gamma egress quota is capped. Last time we saw network throttling at ~350 MB/s. Either reduce batch sizes or request quota bump before full load.

maria: I've raised ticket #TKT-4821 for egress bump. If not approved, fallback is reduce batch token size to 512 and increase per-request delay to 50ms.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary job started: gamma-bootstrap-v1 at 1719346000 — status: success. smoke-tests passed.

nico: During soak: enable prefix caching and set `cache_ttl=12h` for hot models. Also flip `request_queue_backpressure=true` flag in prod flags for first 12h. Sample flag snippet: ```
flags:
  request_queue_backpressure: true
  cache_ttl: 12h
  autoscaler:
    scale_out_threshold: 0.55
    scale_in_cooldown: 600s
```

sarah: I'll wire up dashboards + alerts: latency p50/p95, error_rate, queue_len, gpu_util. Will add runbook alert runbook steps and escalation. Ping me if you flip any flags.

maria: Final ask: can everyone join 08:45 UTC preflight check? Will do a quick smoke, validate quota, confirm priming, then start ramp at 09:00. @ajay @kevin @nico @sarah

ajay: :thumbsup: I'll be there.

kevin: :thumbsup: adding KV priming job to scheduler now.

nico: :thumbsup: I'll post autoscaler before/after configs in this thread once applied.

sarah: :thumbsup: oncall confirmed.

maria: Thanks all. I'll update runbook link (runbook v3): https://confluence.redwood.io/gamma-launch. Leaving notes about cost: estimate ~2000 GPU-hours over first 48h at current pricing, cc finance for cost tracking.
